flavor.phonemic_palette: Sinitic: tonal monosyllables, -ng/-n finals, no consonant clusters (data/conlang/family_east_asian.json, sinitic set)
flavor.phenotype_notes: East Asian; light-to-medium skin, straight black hair, epicanthic folds, medium stature

magic_attitude.notes: Scholar-sages and the heaven-and-ancestor rites are state institutions; freelance sorcery is licensed

architecture_style.signature_feature: tiered roofs, walled cities, and grand canals

flavor_text.one_line: A vast, ancient bureaucratic empire that absorbs its conquerors and reveres heaven and ancestor alike.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Middle Realm of Jinxia endures where others rise and fall, a settled empire of walled cities, scholar-magistrates, and ancestor-shrines bound by the Mandate of Heaven. It expands less by the sword than by the slow gravity of its civilization, sinicizing those it touches; its examined literati and licensed sage-mages hold a martial court in check. Dynasties turn, the realm fractures and reknits, but the bureaucracy and the rites outlast every collapse.
